seoTitle: Oven Temperature Converter: Gas Mark, Celsius, Fan, Fahrenheit
metaDescription: Convert oven settings between gas mark, Celsius, fan Celsius and Fahrenheit using the common UK chart. Free.
intro: Converts recipe oven temperatures between gas mark, conventional Celsius, fan-oven Celsius and Fahrenheit.
why:
UK recipes use gas marks, US recipes Fahrenheit and many ovens are fan-assisted. A fan oven is usually set about 20 C lower.

Enter any one setting and see the others. Gas marks follow the usual chart, which differs by a few degrees between sources.
howTo: Enter the setting from the recipe.
Choose what kind of setting it is.
Read the settings for your oven.
